name: LHRS-Bench
description: LHRS-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models' abilities in remote sensing image understanding, leveraging a large-scale RS image-text dataset and RS-specific instruction data.
reputation: A specialized remote-sensing benchmark that is relevant within the geospatial and multimodal MLLM community, but still relatively new and not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Includes a novel multi-level vision-language alignment strategy and curriculum learning method for RS image understanding.
